decision: SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST — All 7 frozen decision-rule conditions pass: (1) decompressed body-only discrimination >= 0.3 for all 27 chunked cells (min 0.5), (2) decompressed hash determinism all_same=true for all states across all conditions, (3) B-RANDOM = 0.0 for all 27 cells, (4) CL-PASSTHROUGH = 0.5 for all 9 CL cells, (5) 0 decompression errors across all 540 requests, (6) CHUNKED-CACHED discrimination >= 0.3 for all cells (min 0.5), (7) C_ORIGIN_VERIFICATION passes (9/9 content conditions serve TE:chunked without Content-Length). Audit confirms all recomputed metrics match producer exactly. However, the claim ceiling is bounded by three audit findings: (V1) CL-PASSTHROUGH origin was also chunked (contamination of regression control — still passes at 0.5 but not an independent CL-origin baseline), (V2) all compressed body_sizes 70-176 bytes fit in a single chunk (chunk_size=1024), so multi-chunk brotli boundary splitting is untested, (V3) origin verification is on fresh verify servers not the measured origins. The upstream origin->proxy chunked path is genuinely exercised and transparent to proxy reassembly for single-chunk payloads.

claim_updates.reason: Decompression-normalization advances: iterative decompression (brotli->gzip->identity, max_depth=5) preserves decompressed body-only discrimination at 0.5 through end-to-end chunked TE (origin->proxy->client) in both PASSTHROUGH and AUTH-AWARE CACHED modes on localhost mock infrastructure. Parent ceiling (proxy->client chunked downstream only, EXP-RUNTIME-35401995092) is expanded to include origin-served chunked upstream. Three fixes validated: V1 origin chunked (C_ORIGIN_VERIFICATION 9/9 pass), V2 double-header (code inspection), V3 dead code removal (72/72 determinism). Claim ceiling bounded to: single-chunk payloads (compressed 70-176 bytes < chunk_size 1024), Flask/stdlib mock OAuth2 origin brotli quality 6 deterministic, 4 auth states with 3-way error collapse (structural ceiling 0.5), JSON/HTML/XML x 1KB/10KB/100KB, N=540 seed 44 jitter 50-150ms, Python 3.12.14 brotli 1.2.0. CL-PASSTHROUGH regression control contaminated (origin was chunked — see audit V1). NOT validated: multi-chunk reassembly, real CDN (Cloudflare/Fastly/Akamai), Accept-Encoding negotiation, production OAuth/OIDC, binary content, production-scale concurrency, CL-origin isolated baseline.

product_action: Product team may proceed with chunked TE as a supported transport mode on localhost mock infrastructure. The parent's explicit upstream scope gap (origin->proxy chunked) is closed. The remaining blocker for C-MEAS-VALID shifts to real CDN infrastructure only. However, CL-PASSTHROUGH regression should be re-run with isolated CL origin before using the CL baseline to attribute effects in other experiments.
next_question: Does iterative decompression survive real CDN infrastructure (Cloudflare/Fastly/Akamai) with auth-aware cache configuration, chunked TE, Accept-Encoding negotiation, quality variation, and geographic latency — the sole remaining blocker for C-MEAS-VALID product readiness?
reason: All frozen decision conditions pass with audit PASS on recomputed metrics. The upstream chunked path is genuinely exercised (origin serves TE:chunked, C_ORIGIN_VERIFICATION confirms). The claim ceiling is expanded from proxy->client to end-to-end chunked TE on localhost. However, three audit findings bound the ceiling: V1 (CL contamination — regression control not isolated), V2 (single-chunk degeneracy — multi-chunk untested), V3 (indirect origin verification). These are scope limitations, not failures of the primary measurement. The structural discrimination ceiling of 0.5 is a property of 3-way error collapse, not a mechanism limitation. Real CDN infrastructure is the critical untested domain for product readiness.
